svg.title: Prefill runs the prompt in parallel and is often compute-bound; decode generates one token at a time and is usually memory-bound.
svg.desc: Prefill processes the input prompt in parallel and populates the KV cache; long or sufficiently batched prefill can become compute-bound, while short prefill may stay limited by memory traffic or kernel-launch overhead. Decode generates one token at a time, reading model weights and the KV cache from HBM at every step, which makes batch-one decode memory-bandwidth-bound. TTFT covers queueing through the first decode step; TPOT is the average interval between later tokens.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Prefill and decode are different bottlenecks with different metrics

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
